speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis

The chest X-ray showing irregular opacities in the right middle lobe combined with diffuse airway thickening is highly characteristic of bronchiectasis. This chronic structural damage to the airways often results from recurrent infections or underlying inflammatory conditions. Given your history of recurrent bronchitis, this finding strongly supports that diagnosis.

To confirm the extent of the disease and rule out other causes like cystic fibrosis or immune deficiency, I would like to see the results of the spirometry we ordered earlier and consider a CT scan if it hasn't been performed. Do you have any known immune system disorders or a history of alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency?
